observations: Chart children carry no ordering: in Pulumi state the StatefulSet's dependencies are []. On a session-user change the -config ConfigMap and the StatefulSet update in parallel. If the ConfigMap update fails while the StatefulSet roll succeeds, the pods restart on the old no_auth_user. A later up updates only the ConfigMap, the servers refuse that reload (NoAuthUser), and the old session user stays with a clean preview. This was not driven to failure; it is a risk for the reviewer to weigh.

The tailnet advertiser was not driven against a real tailscaled (no tailnet auth key on this surface); its behaviour is pinned by the shared tailnet_service_test.go stubs (INFRA-560's code byte for byte). The README PromQL and the GKE-only pieces (GMP collection, Dataplane V2 enforcement, Autopilot scheduling) are INFRA-551's live proof.
